description:
Immediately halt, pause, resume, or unstick behavior execution and disengage active inputs (actions: abort, pause, resume, unstick). Use abort_behavior instead of register_trigger when manually halting or recovering execution rather than configuring automatic condition interrupts.

Returns transition status, disengaged inputs, and unstick diagnostics.

action.description: Execution control operation: abort, pause, resume, unstick (resets stuck score and disengages inputs)

name: abort_behavior
